question: Can I put different icons on both sides of a button - like an eye on the left and an arrow on the right? What properties control this and which icons are available?
ground_truth: Yes, you can add icons to both ends of a button using the `icon` prop for the left side and the `rightIcon` prop for the right side. For example: `<Button icon="eye" rightIcon="arrow-right">Preview</Button>` creates a button with an eye icon on the left and an arrow icon on the right, flanking the text. You can mix and match any icon names - they don't have to be the same. The icon names reference Fern's built-in icon library, which includes common icons like 'download', 'arrow-right', 'star', 'eye', etc. You can use any available icon from this library for either prop, giving you flexibility to combine different icons to communicate the button's action effectively.
